### Jerusalem Captured
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jerusalem-captured
Passage: 2 Kings 25:1
Points:
- King Zedekiah rebelled against Babylon by leaning on worldly alliances rather than trusting God, triggering a brutal two-year siege of Jerusalem.
- Severe famine weakened the defenders until the city wall was breached, causing the king and his troops to flee by night.
- Babylonian forces overtook Zedekiah near Jericho, executing his sons before his eyes and blinding him before deporting him in chains.
- Jerusalem’s fall illustrates that although God is remarkably patient, He will not tolerate persistent rebellion indefinitely.
- Christians should never presume upon God's patience, but should turn quickly from sin to avoid experiencing severe divine discipline.
